outcome: Enable a work owner to see only structurally admissible options, make or preserve one explicit consequential decision, and retain a durable rationale and blocker state before downstream mutation continues.
scope: Classify candidate options, preserve defer and stop, route zero, one, or multiple admissible options exactly, present human-owned trade-offs, and persist the resulting decision state.
exclusions: treating a direct route as consent or execution
granting mutation, publication, promotion, spend, deployment, or external-effect authority
